name: CSG Model Voxelization
aliases: Basic CSG Voxelization by Frame Buffer Pixel Mapping
CSG Model Voxelization — Boolean CSG voxelization
Hardware-Assisted Frame Buffer Pixel Mapping for CSG Voxelization
definition: Voxelization of Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) models by voxelizing nodes into worksheets and performing boolean operations in image space using GPU blending.
summary: CSG Model Voxelization is a hardware-accelerated algorithm that rasterizes primitives into frame buffer colors and uses a Point-Classification Map to compute final CSG classifications, differing from SDF methods by operating in image space.
